_template_notes.purpose: Table-level data config for single data flow pipeline. Separate from the dtxog config which controls Glue job infrastructure.
_template_notes.scenario: Single data flow — all source tables originate from one database/system. Use this template when domain_knowledge does not specify a source_system field.
_template_notes.source: Source tables are organized under three keys: 'non-transactional' (SCD2 sources with eff_start/end/active), 'non-transactional-scd1' (SCD1 sources with dw_lod_tmp/dw_upd_lod_tmp only), and 'transactional' (append-only). The template shows examples — add or remove entries as required.
_template_notes.source_placement_rule: Source classified as NonTransactional_SCD2 → 'non-transactional' key. Source classified as NonTransactional_SCD1 → 'non-transactional-scd1' key. Source classified as Transactional → 'transactional' key.
_template_notes.columns: Each source table entry lists only the columns needed for the transformation. Add or remove column entries to match the mapping document — no fixed limit.
_template_notes.filters: Three-case resolution: (1) No alias key for a table → 'default' filter applied. (2) Alias key present → that filter used exclusively; 'default' is NOT merged — write the combined expression explicitly if both are needed. (3) To suppress the default entirely for a table → set alias to '1=1'; this overrides the default and results in no effective row restriction. Date columns (eff_start_date, eff_end_date, dw_bus_dt, plus any listed in 'date_columns') are automatically rewritten to CAST(col AS DATE) <op> CAST('date' AS DATE) by SourceReader — write plain comparisons in config; do not add CAST manually.
_template_notes.date_columns: Optional. List pipeline-specific date columns beyond the standard set (eff_start_date, eff_end_date, dw_bus_dt). SourceReader auto-applies CAST(col AS DATE) for all columns in this list when they appear in filter expressions. Omit the key entirely if no additional date columns are required.
_template_notes.crypto: The crypto section is included only when the crypto flow is active for this pipeline. Remove the entire crypto block if no tokenization or detokenization is required.
_template_notes.file_locations: S3 paths for staging, checkpoint, and date control files. No source_system prefix — single data flow scenario.
_template_notes.staging_path: General-purpose intermediate staging S3 prefix. Used by transform when multi-step logic needs materialization between stages. The transform constructs the full S3 URI as s3://{s3_bucket}/{staging_path}/step_name.
_template_notes.environments: Per-environment S3 bucket names. The wrapper resolves config['environments'][env]['s3_bucket'] at runtime using the env parameter passed by the DTX framework. Values sourced from session_state.env_config.{env}.s3_bucket during generation.
_template_notes.rolling_deletion: Optional. Applicable to Transactional and NonTransactional_SCD1 only. Omit entirely for NonTransactional_SCD2. {current_business_date} is interpolated at runtime.
_template_notes.source_file: source.file is conditionally populated by /gen-config STEP 1.8 when io_mode is 'file' or 'hybrid'. Omitted entirely for table-only pipelines.
_template_notes.target_io: target_io is conditionally populated by /gen-config STEP 3.8 when target is a parquet file. When present, the cdc and rolling_deletion sections are omitted.

cdc._notes: For NonTransactional_SCD2: include primary_key_cols, exclude_cols, snapshot_mode. For NonTransactional_SCD1: include ONLY primary_key_cols, exclude_cols (no snapshot_mode, no high_ended_date). For Transactional: omit entire cdc section. NOTE: validate_unique_keys, duplicates_ts_col, dedup_order are NOT applicable to Glue platform (run_cdc is Databricks-only).
